name: swk-os-mobile
description: SWK Properties OS unified Capacitor 7 Android (APK/AAB) & iOS mobile shell wrapping SWKOS/dist/web

scripts.android:sync: node scripts/gen-nsc.mjs && node scripts/sync-web.mjs && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:aab: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease
